# NEW 2026-11-20 v6.9 reg-albania23, Albania and Skanderbeg, phases 1-3. Generated by gen_albania.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope, monthly. Called by the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py LINES id 35); this line writes no monthly
# hook of its own. Order (design 4.1): open, close (1480.1.1); next-month land check, world steps, at most one event, notices
# .91 and .92, then January.
oe_alb_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_alb_off } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_alb_live } } set_global_variable = oe_alb_live }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_alb_on } } set_variable = oe_alb_on }
        set_variable = { name = oe_alb_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
        if = {
            limit = { current_date >= 1480.1.1 }
            set_variable = oe_alb_off
            debug_log = "oe_alb: the line is closed (ws [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_alb_v_ws')|0]/[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_alb_v_ws2')|0]/[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_alb_v_ws3')|0])"
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { current_date >= 1384.1.1 }
            oe_alb_check = yes
            oe_alb_world = yes
            oe_alb_events = yes
            if = { limit = { current_month = 1 } oe_alb_january = yes }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. The land steps are checked again the month after they ran (design 4.1): 1 still so, 5 not any more.
oe_alb_check = {
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_alb_chk_2 ?= 9 }
        if = { limit = { location:durres = { owner ?= c:VEN } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_chk_2 value = 1 } }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_chk_2 value = 5 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_alb_chk_3 ?= 9 }
        if = {
            limit = {
                OR = { NOT = { global_var:oe_alb_lezha ?= 1 } location:lezha = { owner ?= c:VEN } }
                OR = { NOT = { global_var:oe_alb_shkoder ?= 1 } location:shkoder = { owner ?= c:VEN } }
            }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_chk_3 value = 1 }
        }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_chk_3 value = 5 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_alb_chk_4 ?= 9 }
        if = { limit = { OR = { NOT = { global_var:oe_alb_s_avlonya ?= 1 } location:avlonya = { owner ?= c:TUR } } OR = { NOT = { global_var:oe_alb_s_berat ?= 1 } location:berat = { owner ?= c:TUR } } OR = { NOT = { global_var:oe_alb_s_ballsh ?= 1 } location:ballsh = { owner ?= c:TUR } } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_chk_4 value = 1 } }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_chk_4 value = 5 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_alb_chk_6 ?= 9 }
        if = { limit = { oe_alb_sk_alive = yes location:kruje = { owner ?= global_var:oe_alb_sk_c } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_chk_6 value = 1 } }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_chk_6 value = 5 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_alb_chk_8 ?= 9 }
        if = { limit = { location:kruje = { owner ?= c:TUR } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_chk_8 value = 1 } }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_chk_8 value = 5 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_alb_chk_10 ?= 9 }
        if = { limit = { location:kruje = { owner ?= c:TUR } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_chk_10 value = 1 } }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_chk_10 value = 5 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_alb_chk_12 ?= 9 }
        if = {
            limit = {
                OR = { NOT = { global_var:oe_alb_kr3 ?= 1 } location:kruje = { owner ?= c:TUR } }
                OR = { NOT = { global_var:oe_alb_shk_fell ?= 1 } location:shkoder = { owner ?= c:TUR } }
            }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_chk_12 value = 1 }
        }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_chk_12 value = 5 } }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. World steps W1-W12 (design 4.2): in its window each step is skipped (3) when a player or the bloc is
# concerned; else it runs with its chance when ready; after the window, 2.
oe_alb_world = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_alb_ws_1 } var:oe_alb_m >= 582 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_m > 588 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_1 value = 2 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_alb_w1_skip = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_1 value = 3 } }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_alb_w1_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_alb_wch_1 oe_alb_w1_run = yes } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_alb_ws_2 } var:oe_alb_m >= 654 }
        if = { limit = { oe_alb_w2_skip = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_2 value = 3 } }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_alb_c2 ?= 3 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_alb_m > 816 }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_2 value = 2 }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_durres value = 3 }
            }
            else_if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_m >= 781 oe_alb_w2_ok = yes } random = { chance = oe_alb_wch_2l oe_alb_w2_run = yes } }
        }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_m > 672 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_2 value = 2 } }
        else_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_alb_w2_now oe_alb_w2_ok = yes } oe_alb_w2_run = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { oe_alb_w2_ok = yes oe_alb_e2_open = no } random = { chance = oe_alb_wch_2 oe_alb_w2_run = yes } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_alb_ws_3 } var:oe_alb_m >= 673 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_m > 720 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_3 value = 2 } }

# BYZ scope. W1 Savra (1385.6-1385.12). Every Albanian lord gets oe_alb_savra_tribute for 20 years and +20 opinion of TUR;
# Zeta loses prestige and hands Durazzo to the Thopia where it holds it in hand. No subject relation (design 7.2).
oe_alb_w1 = {
    every_country = {
        limit = { oe_alb_lord = yes }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_alb_savra_tribute years = 20 mode = replace }
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TUR } add_opinion = { modifier = oe_alb_savra target = c:TUR } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:ZTA c:ZTA = { is_ai = yes NOT = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } }
        c:ZTA = { add_prestige = -10 }
        if = {
            limit = {
                country_exists = c:THP c:THP = { is_ai = yes NOT = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } }
                location:durres = { owner ?= c:ZTA controller ?= c:ZTA has_siege = no is_capital = no }
            }
            location:durres = { change_location_owner = c:THP change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus } }
            if = { limit = { location:durres = { owner ?= c:THP } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_savra_dur value = 1 } }
        }
    }
    set_variable = { name = oe_alb_savra_m value = var:oe_alb_m }
    if = { limit = { oe_alb_v_lords > 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_1 value = 1 } }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_1 value = 5 } }
}
# BYZ scope. W2 Venetian Durazzo. The owner is paid 3 months of its own income, both gain opinion, Durazzo passes to Venice.
oe_alb_w2 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_alb_w2_ok = yes }
        location:durres = {
            if = {
                limit = { oe_alb_loc_free = yes }
                owner = { save_scope_as = oe_alb_giver }
                scope:oe_alb_giver = { add_gold = oe_alb_v_annuity add_opinion = { modifier = oe_alb_ven_deal target = c:VEN } }
                c:VEN = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_alb_ven_deal target = scope:oe_alb_giver } }
                change_location_owner = c:VEN change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus }
            }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { location:durres = { owner ?= c:VEN } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_2 value = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_durres value = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_chk_2 value = 9 }
    }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_2 value = 5 } }
}
# BYZ scope. W3 Lezhë and Scutari. Lezhë to Venice where it qualifies; Scutari where Zeta or a lord seated in Zeta holds it.
oe_alb_w3 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_alb_ven_ok = yes oe_alb_w3_lezha = yes }
        location:lezha = {
            if = {
                limit = { oe_alb_loc_free = yes }
                owner = { save_scope_as = oe_alb_giver }
                change_location_owner = c:VEN change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus }
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { location:lezha = { owner ?= c:VEN } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_lezha value = 1 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_alb_ven_ok = yes oe_alb_w3_shkoder = yes }
        location:shkoder = {
            if = {
                limit = { oe_alb_loc_free = yes }
                owner = { save_scope_as = oe_alb_giver }
                scope:oe_alb_giver = { add_gold = oe_alb_v_annuity add_opinion = { modifier = oe_alb_ven_deal target = c:VEN } }
                c:VEN = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_alb_ven_deal target = scope:oe_alb_giver } }
                change_location_owner = c:VEN change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus }
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { location:shkoder = { owner ?= c:VEN } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_shkoder value = 1 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { OR = { global_var:oe_alb_lezha ?= 1 global_var:oe_alb_shkoder ?= 1 } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_3 value = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_chk_3 value = 9 }
    }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_3 value = 5 } }
}
# BYZ scope. W4 the south. Each of avlonya, berat, ballsh that qualifies passes to the Ottomans.
oe_alb_w4 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_south value = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_alb_w4_loc = { loc = avlonya } }
        location:avlonya = {
            if = {
                limit = { oe_alb_loc_free = yes }
                owner = { save_scope_as = oe_alb_giver }
                change_location_owner = c:TUR change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus }
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { location:avlonya = { owner ?= c:TUR } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_s_avlonya value = 1 } change_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_south add = 1 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_alb_w4_loc = { loc = berat } }
        location:berat = {
            if = {
                limit = { oe_alb_loc_free = yes }
                owner = { save_scope_as = oe_alb_giver }
                change_location_owner = c:TUR change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus }
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { location:berat = { owner ?= c:TUR } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_s_berat value = 1 } change_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_south add = 1 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_alb_w4_loc = { loc = ballsh } }
        location:ballsh = {
            if = {
                limit = { oe_alb_loc_free = yes }
                owner = { save_scope_as = oe_alb_giver }
                change_location_owner = c:TUR change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus }
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { location:ballsh = { owner ?= c:TUR } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_s_ballsh value = 1 } change_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_south add = 1 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { global_var:oe_alb_south ?= 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_4 value = 5 }
    }
    else = {
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_4 value = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_chk_4 value = 9 }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. W5 Revolt of 1432 (phase 2): unrest on TUR locations in Albania, morale and prestige on AI Albanian lords. No land moves.
oe_alb_w5 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_alb_w5_ok = yes }
        c:TUR = {
            every_owned_location = {
                limit = { area = area:albania_area }
                add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_alb_revolt_1432 years = 4 mode = replace }
            }
        }
        every_country = {
            limit = { oe_alb_lord = yes }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_alb_rebels years = 4 mode = replace }
            add_prestige = 5
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:TUR c:TUR = { any_owned_location = { has_location_modifier = oe_alb_revolt_1432 } } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_5 value = 1 }
    }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_5 value = 5 } }
}
# BYZ scope. W6 helper (cases 2 & 3; also called by albsk): dynamic country from Krujë (probe 7), Skanderbeg as ruler, Debar if same owner.
oe_alb_spawn_sk = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_alb_kruje_w6_ok = yes }
        location:kruje = {
            owner = { save_scope_as = oe_alb_sk_old }
            create_country_from_location = {
                save_scope_as = oe_alb_sk_new
                change_government_type = government_type:monarchy
                change_country_type = location
                change_religion = religion:orthodox
                change_culture = culture:albanian
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_alb_sk_new location:kruje = { owner ?= scope:oe_alb_sk_new } }
            scope:oe_alb_sk_new = {
                change_country_name = oe_alb_kruje_name
                change_country_adjective = oe_alb_kruje_adj
                if = {
                    limit = { exists = character:skanderbeg_kastrioti character:skanderbeg_kastrioti = { is_alive = yes is_ruler = no } }
                    character:skanderbeg_kastrioti = { move_country = scope:oe_alb_sk_new }
                    set_new_ruler = character:skanderbeg_kastrioti
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_sk value = 2 }
                }
                else = {
                    if = {
                        limit = { NOT = { exists = character:oe_alb_skanderbeg } }
                        if = {
                            limit = { current_date >= 1421.1.1 }
                            create_character = {
                                first_name = name_george
                                nickname = nick_skanderbeg
                                dynasty = dynasty:kastrioti_dynasty
                                culture = culture:albanian
                                religion = religion:orthodox
                                estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
                                female = no
                                birth_date = 1405.5.6
                                adm = 75 dip = 70 mil = 92
                                script = oe_alb_skanderbeg
                            }
                        }
                        else = {
                            create_character = {
                                first_name = name_george
                                nickname = nick_skanderbeg
                                dynasty = dynasty:kastrioti_dynasty
                                culture = culture:albanian
                                religion = religion:orthodox
                                estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
                                female = no
                                age = 35
                                adm = 75 dip = 70 mil = 92
                                script = oe_alb_skanderbeg
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { exists = character:oe_alb_skanderbeg character:oe_alb_skanderbeg = { is_alive = yes } }
                        character:oe_alb_skanderbeg = { move_country = scope:oe_alb_sk_new }
                        set_new_ruler = character:oe_alb_skanderbeg
                    }
                    set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_sk value = 3 }
                }
            }
            location:debar = {
                if = {
                    limit = { owner ?= scope:oe_alb_sk_old controller ?= scope:oe_alb_sk_old has_siege = no is_capital = no }
                    change_location_owner = scope:oe_alb_sk_new change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus }
                }
            }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_sk_c value = scope:oe_alb_sk_new }
            set_variable = { name = oe_alb_sk_m value = var:oe_alb_m }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_6 value = 1 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_chk_6 value = 9 }
        }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_6 value = 5 } }
    }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_6 value = 5 } }
}
# BYZ scope. W6 Banner over Krujë (phase 2, design 4.3): case 1 vanilla ruler, else spawn dynamic country (cases 2 & 3).
oe_alb_w6 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_alb_van_sk_ruler = yes character:skanderbeg_kastrioti = { owner ?= { is_ai = yes NOT = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } } }
        character:skanderbeg_kastrioti = { owner = { save_scope_as = oe_alb_sk_new } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_sk value = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_sk_c value = scope:oe_alb_sk_new }
        set_variable = { name = oe_alb_sk_m value = var:oe_alb_m }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_6 value = 1 }
    }
    else = { oe_alb_spawn_sk = yes }
}
# BYZ scope. W7 League of Lezhë (phase 2): defensive modifier, -30 TUR, +40 mutual among AI members.
oe_alb_w7 = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_league value = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_alb_w7_ok = yes }
        every_country = {
            limit = { oe_alb_league_member = yes }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_alb_league years = 25 mode = replace }
            if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TUR } add_opinion = { modifier = oe_alb_league_tur target = c:TUR } }
            save_scope_as = oe_alb_lm
            every_country = {
                limit = { oe_alb_league_member = yes NOT = { this = scope:oe_alb_lm } }
                add_opinion = { modifier = oe_alb_league_brothers target = scope:oe_alb_lm }
            }
            change_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_league add = 1 }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_alb_league global_var:oe_alb_league > 0 } set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_7 value = 1 } }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_7 value = 5 } }
}
# BYZ scope. W8 Siege of Krujë I (phase 2): roll oe_alb_kr1_chance; held -> modifiers & prestige; fell -> Krujë to TUR (settled).
oe_alb_w8 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_alb_w8_ok = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_alb_kr1_p value = oe_alb_kr1_chance }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_kr1 value = 2 }
        random = { chance = oe_alb_kr1_chance set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_kr1 value = 1 } }
        if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_alb_kr1 ?= 1 }
            global_var:oe_alb_sk_c = { add_prestige = 20 }
            location:kruje = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_alb_kruje_held years = 20 mode = replace } }
            c:TUR = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_alb_kruje_shame years = 5 mode = replace } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_8 value = 1 }
        }
        else = {
            location:kruje = { change_location_owner = c:TUR change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus } }
            if = {
                limit = { location:kruje = { owner ?= c:TUR } }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_8 value = 1 }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_chk_8 value = 9 }
            }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_8 value = 5 } }
        }
    }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_8 value = 5 } }
}
# BYZ scope. W9 Berat & Albulena (phase 3): stage 1 Berat setback; stage 2 Albulena victory (modifiers only).
oe_alb_w9 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_alb_w9_ok = yes }
        if = {
            limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_alb_w9_berat } }
            global_var:oe_alb_sk_c = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_alb_berat_loss years = 3 mode = replace } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_w9_berat value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_alb_w9_m value = var:oe_alb_m }
        }
        else = {
            global_var:oe_alb_sk_c = { add_prestige = 15 }
            every_country = {
                limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_alb_league }
                add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_alb_league years = 25 mode = replace }
            }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_9 value = 1 }
        }
    }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_9 value = 5 } }
}
# BYZ scope. W10 New Fort & Renewed Siege (phase 3): build vanilla castle at Elbasan if TUR holds it, then roll Krujë siege II.
oe_alb_w10 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_alb_w10_ok = yes }
        if = {
            limit = { location:elbasan = { owner ?= c:TUR controller ?= c:TUR has_siege = no } }
            location:elbasan = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_building = building_type:castle }
                        NOT = { has_building = building_type:bastion }
                        NOT = { has_building = building_type:star_fort }
                        NOT = { has_building = building_type:fortress }
                    }
                    construct_building = { building_type = building_type:castle owner = c:TUR instant = yes cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" }
                }
                add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_alb_new_fort years = 20 mode = replace }
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_alb_kr2_p value = oe_alb_kr2_chance }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_kr2 value = 2 }
        random = { chance = oe_alb_kr2_chance set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_kr2 value = 1 } }
        if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_alb_kr2 ?= 1 }
            global_var:oe_alb_sk_c = { add_prestige = 20 }
            location:kruje = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_alb_kruje_held years = 20 mode = replace } }
            c:TUR = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_alb_kruje_shame years = 5 mode = replace } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_10 value = 1 }
        }
        else = {
            location:kruje = { change_location_owner = c:TUR change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus } }
            if = {
                limit = { location:kruje = { owner ?= c:TUR } }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_10 value = 1 }
                set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_chk_10 value = 9 }
            }
            else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_10 value = 5 } }
        }
    }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_10 value = 5 } }
}
# BYZ scope. W11 After Skanderbeg (phase 3): clear oe_alb_league everywhere, apply oe_alb_after_sk. Succession left to engine (design 7.8).
oe_alb_w11 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_alb_sk_ai = yes }
        every_country = {
            limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_alb_league }
            remove_country_modifier = oe_alb_league
        }
        global_var:oe_alb_sk_c = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_alb_after_sk years = 10 mode = replace } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_alb_sk_dead_m value = var:oe_alb_m }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_alb_ref_m } } set_variable = { name = oe_alb_ref_m value = var:oe_alb_m } }
        if = {
            limit = { global_var:oe_alb_sk_c = { has_country_modifier = oe_alb_after_sk } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_11 value = 1 }
        }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_11 value = 5 } }
    }
    else = { set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_11 value = 5 } }
}
# BYZ scope. W12 Krujë and Scutari (phase 3): Krujë to TUR (settled); Scutari from VEN to TUR (settled) + peace opinion. Durazzo untouched.
oe_alb_w12_do_kruje = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_alb_w12_kruje = yes }
        location:kruje = { change_location_owner = c:TUR change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus } }
        if = {
            limit = { location:kruje = { owner ?= c:TUR } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_kr3 value = 1 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_12 value = 1 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_chk_12 value = 9 }
            if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_alb_ref_m } } set_variable = { name = oe_alb_ref_m value = var:oe_alb_m } }
        }
    }
}
oe_alb_w12_do_shkoder = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_alb_w12_shkoder = yes }
        location:shkoder = { change_location_owner = c:TUR change_integration_level = integrated change_control = control_radical_bonus every_pop = { add_pop_satisfaction = pop_satisfaction_ultimate_bonus } }
        if = {
            limit = { location:shkoder = { owner ?= c:TUR } }
            c:VEN = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_alb_shkoder_peace target = c:TUR } }
            c:TUR = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_alb_shkoder_peace target = c:VEN } }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_shk_fell value = 1 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_12 value = 1 }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_chk_12 value = 9 }
        }
    }
}
oe_alb_w12 = {
    if = { limit = { oe_alb_w12_kruje = yes } oe_alb_w12_do_kruje = yes }
    if = { limit = { oe_alb_w12_shkoder = yes } oe_alb_w12_do_shkoder = yes }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { global_var:oe_alb_ws_12 ?= 1 } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_ws_12 value = 5 } }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. Events (design 4.4): lapse; at most one event (lock, calm, 6 months since the last); notices .91, .92.
oe_alb_events = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_alb_c12_m } OR = { var:oe_col_c12 ?= 1 var:oe_col_c12 ?= 2 } } set_variable = { name = oe_alb_c12_m value = var:oe_alb_m } }
    if = { limit = { oe_alb_gone_1 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_alb_st_1 value = 3 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_alb_late_1 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_alb_st_1 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_alb_gone_2 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_alb_st_2 value = 3 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_alb_late_2 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_alb_st_2 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_alb_gone_3 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_alb_st_3 value = 3 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_alb_late_3 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_alb_st_3 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_alb_gone_4 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_alb_st_4 value = 3 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_alb_late_4 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_alb_st_4 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_alb_gone_5 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_alb_st_5 value = 3 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_alb_late_5 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_alb_st_5 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_alb_gone_6 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_alb_st_6 value = 3 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_alb_late_6 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_alb_st_6 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_alb_gone_7 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_alb_st_7 value = 3 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_alb_late_7 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_alb_st_7 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_alb_gone_8 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_alb_st_8 value = 3 } }
    if = { limit = { oe_alb_late_8 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_alb_st_8 value = 2 } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_alb_pick value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_pick = 0 NOT = { has_variable = oe_alb_gap } oe_ml_free = yes oe_alb_calm = yes oe_alb_ok_1 = yes } random = { chance = oe_alb_ch_1 set_variable = { name = oe_alb_pick value = 1 } } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_pick = 0 NOT = { has_variable = oe_alb_gap } oe_ml_free = yes oe_alb_calm = yes oe_alb_ok_2 = yes } random = { chance = oe_alb_ch_2 set_variable = { name = oe_alb_pick value = 2 } } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_pick = 0 NOT = { has_variable = oe_alb_gap } oe_ml_free = yes oe_alb_calm = yes oe_alb_ok_3 = yes } random = { chance = oe_alb_ch_3 set_variable = { name = oe_alb_pick value = 3 } } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_pick = 0 NOT = { has_variable = oe_alb_gap } oe_ml_free = yes oe_alb_calm = yes oe_alb_ok_4 = yes } random = { chance = oe_alb_ch_4 set_variable = { name = oe_alb_pick value = 4 } } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_pick = 0 NOT = { has_variable = oe_alb_gap } oe_ml_free = yes oe_alb_calm = yes oe_alb_ok_5 = yes } random = { chance = oe_alb_ch_5 set_variable = { name = oe_alb_pick value = 5 } } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_pick = 0 NOT = { has_variable = oe_alb_gap } oe_ml_free = yes oe_alb_calm = yes oe_alb_ok_6 = yes } random = { chance = oe_alb_ch_6 set_variable = { name = oe_alb_pick value = 6 } } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_pick = 0 NOT = { has_variable = oe_alb_gap } oe_ml_free = yes oe_alb_calm = yes oe_alb_ok_7 = yes } random = { chance = oe_alb_ch_7 set_variable = { name = oe_alb_pick value = 7 } } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_pick = 0 NOT = { has_variable = oe_alb_gap } oe_ml_free = yes oe_alb_calm = yes oe_alb_ok_8 = yes } random = { chance = oe_alb_ch_8 set_variable = { name = oe_alb_pick value = 8 } } }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_pick = 1 } oe_alb_send_1 = yes }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_pick = 2 } oe_alb_send_2 = yes }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_pick = 3 } oe_alb_send_3 = yes }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_pick = 4 } oe_alb_send_4 = yes }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_pick = 5 } oe_alb_send_5 = yes }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_pick = 6 } oe_alb_send_6 = yes }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_pick = 7 } oe_alb_send_7 = yes }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_pick = 8 } oe_alb_send_8 = yes }
    remove_variable = oe_alb_pick
    if = { limit = { oe_alb_ok_91 = yes } oe_alb_send_91 = yes }
    if = { limit = { oe_alb_ok_92a = yes } oe_alb_send_92a = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { oe_alb_ok_92b = yes } oe_alb_send_92b = yes }
}
# BYZ scope. The sender of each event: its state (st 1), the gap, and the event.
oe_alb_send_1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_alb_st_1 value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_alb_last value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_alb_gap months = 6 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_alb.1 }

    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_alb_kr1_p } } set_variable = { name = oe_alb_kr1_p value = oe_alb_kr1_chance } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_alb_n92 value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_alb_st_92a value = 1 }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_alb.92
}

    set_variable = { name = oe_alb_n92 value = 2 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_alb_st_92b value = 1 }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_alb.92
}

# BYZ scope, January. .3 b: the wages of the Arcadian horse, one month of income a year while years are left.
oe_alb_january = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_alb_pay_left var:oe_alb_pay_left > 0 }
        oe_alb_pay = { months = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_alb_pay_left add = -1 }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Pay $months$ months of income (oe_fin_month; never below 10 gold a month).
oe_alb_pay = { add_gold = { value = oe_fin_month multiply = -$months$ } }

# BYZ scope. Frees C2's oe_dsp_t slot if .6 filled it.
oe_alb_drop_dsp_t = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_alb_dsp_t_mine }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_dsp_t } remove_variable = oe_dsp_t }
        remove_variable = oe_alb_dsp_t_mine
    }
}

# BYZ scope. The worker oe_alb.90: every option of the line sets oe_alb_do and wakes it (no work in an option preview).
oe_alb_work = {
    if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_do ?= 11 } oe_alb_job_11 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_do ?= 12 } oe_alb_job_12 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_do ?= 13 } oe_alb_job_13 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_do ?= 21 } oe_alb_job_21 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_do ?= 22 } oe_alb_job_22 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_do ?= 23 } oe_alb_job_23 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_do ?= 31 } oe_alb_job_31 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_do ?= 32 } oe_alb_job_32 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_do ?= 33 } oe_alb_job_33 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_do ?= 41 } oe_alb_job_41 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_do ?= 42 } oe_alb_job_42 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_do ?= 43 } oe_alb_job_43 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_do ?= 51 } oe_alb_job_51 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_do ?= 52 } oe_alb_job_52 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_do ?= 53 } oe_alb_job_53 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_do ?= 61 } oe_alb_job_61 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_do ?= 62 } oe_alb_job_62 = yes }

    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_do ?= 71 } oe_alb_job_71 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_do ?= 72 } oe_alb_job_72 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_do ?= 73 } oe_alb_job_73 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_do ?= 81 } oe_alb_job_81 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_alb_do ?= 82 } oe_alb_job_82 = yes }

# 11: .1 a, envoys to the lords.
oe_alb_job_11 = {
    oe_alb_pay = { months = 0.5 }
    every_country = { limit = { oe_alb_lord = yes } add_opinion = { modifier = oe_alb_envoys target = c:BYZ } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TUR } c:TUR = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_alb_envoys_tur target = c:BYZ } } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_alb_c1 value = 1 }
}
# 12: .1 b, congratulations to the sultan.

    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:TUR } c:TUR = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_alb_congrats target = c:BYZ } } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_vas_stage country_exists = c:TUR is_subject_of = c:TUR } oe_vas_add_patience = { amount = 5 } }
    every_country = { limit = { oe_alb_lord = yes } add_opinion = { modifier = oe_alb_snub target = c:BYZ } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_alb_c1 value = 2 }
}

    set_variable = { name = oe_alb_c1 value = 3 }

# 21: .2 a, Durazzo bought in peace.
oe_alb_job_21 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_alb_ev_2 = yes oe_alb_can_pay = { months = 6 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_alb_price value = oe_alb_v_m6 }
        location:durres = { owner = { save_scope_as = oe_alb_giver } }
        oe_alb_pay = { months = 6 }
        scope:oe_alb_giver = { add_gold = root.var:oe_alb_price }
        location:durres = { change_location_owner = c:BYZ }
        remove_variable = oe_alb_price
        if = { limit = { country_exists = c:VEN } c:VEN = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_alb_durres_bought target = c:BYZ } } }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_t_ven var:oe_itp_t_ven >= 2 } if = { limit = { country_exists = c:VEN } c:VEN = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_alb_durres_bought_x target = c:BYZ } } } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_alb_durres value = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_alb_fail value = 0 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_alb_fail value = 21 } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_alb_c2 value = 1 }
}

# 71: .7 a, settle refugees via D3 oe_col_settle_p2.
oe_alb_job_71 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_alb_can_pay = { months = 1 } oe_alb_ref_site = yes }
        oe_alb_pay = { months = 1 }
        ordered_owned_location = {
            limit = { oe_col_site = yes oe_col_albanian_lands = yes }
            order_by = { value = population multiply = -1 }
            max = 1
            save_scope_as = oe_col_loc
        }
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:oe_col_loc }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_p2_group } set_variable = { name = oe_alb_col_keep value = var:oe_col_p2_group } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_col_p2_group value = 1 }
            oe_col_settle_p2 = yes
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_alb_col_keep } set_variable = { name = oe_col_p2_group value = var:oe_alb_col_keep } remove_variable = oe_alb_col_keep }
            else = { remove_variable = oe_col_p2_group }
            set_variable = { name = oe_alb_fail value = 0 }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_alb_fail value = 71 } }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_alb_fail value = 71 } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_alb_c7 value = 1 }
}

durres=[GetLocationByKey('durres').GetOwner.GetName] lezha=[GetLocationByKey('lezha').GetOwner.GetName] shkoder=[GetLocationByKey('shkoder').GetOwner.GetName] }
# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. The assimilation readout (albassim; design 1.5): preserves phase 1 readout verbatim.
oe_alb_test_assim = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_alb_as_loc } remove_variable = oe_alb_as_loc }
    set_variable = { name = oe_alb_as_pct value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_alb_as_byz value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_rw_albania_romanization_started } set_variable = { name = oe_alb_as_byz value = 1 } }
    area:albania_area = {
        ordered_location_in_area = {
            limit = { oe_rw_albania_origin_ge25 = yes }
            max = 1
            check_range_bounds = no
            order_by = {
                value = population
                multiply = oe_rw_assim_albania_source_share
                if = { limit = { oe_rw_albania_origin_ge50 = yes } add = 10000000 }
                if = { limit = { this = location:durres } add = 1000000 }
                if = { limit = { owner = c:BYZ } add = 100000000 }
            }
            save_scope_as = oe_alb_as_top
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_alb_as_top }
        set_variable = { name = oe_alb_as_loc value = scope:oe_alb_as_top }
        scope:oe_alb_as_top = { set_variable = { name = oe_alb_as_pct value = oe_alb_v_albpct } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_alb_as_pct value = scope:oe_alb_as_top.var:oe_alb_as_pct }
        scope:oe_alb_as_top = { remove_variable = oe_alb_as_pct }
    }
    debug_log = "oe_alb assimilation: owned [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_rw_assim_albania_owned')|0] of [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_rw_assim_albania_total')|0], needed [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_rw_assim_albania_required')|0]; started [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_alb_v_asbyz')|0] (1 the movement was started); the start rule's first place [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_alb_as_loc').GetLocation.GetName] with [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_alb_v_aspct')|0]% Albanians (0 and no name: no place qualifies)"
}
# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. Spawn Skanderbeg's dynamic realm (albsk, W6 case 2/3, Krujë AI-owned).
oe_alb_test_sk = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_alb_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_alb_kruje_w6_ok = yes }
        oe_alb_spawn_sk = yes
        debug_log = "oe_alb test albsk: sk=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_alb_v_sk')|0] ws2=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_alb_v_ws2')|0] kruje=[GetLocationByKey('kruje').GetOwner.GetName]"
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_alb test albsk: cannot run (Kruje must be held in hand by an AI owner outside the bloc)" }
}
# TEST PAGE ONLY. BYZ scope. Roll W8 Siege of Krujë formula 10 times without mutating map (albkr).
oe_alb_test_kr = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_alb_kr1_p value = oe_alb_kr1_chance }
    set_variable = { name = oe_alb_kr_win value = 0 }
    random = { chance = oe_alb_kr1_chance change_variable = { name = oe_alb_kr_win add = 1 } }
    random = { chance = oe_alb_kr1_chance change_variable = { name = oe_alb_kr_win add = 1 } }
    random = { chance = oe_alb_kr1_chance change_variable = { name = oe_alb_kr_win add = 1 } }
    random = { chance = oe_alb_kr1_chance change_variable = { name = oe_alb_kr_win add = 1 } }
    random = { chance = oe_alb_kr1_chance change_variable = { name = oe_alb_kr_win add = 1 } }
    random = { chance = oe_alb_kr1_chance change_variable = { name = oe_alb_kr_win add = 1 } }
    random = { chance = oe_alb_kr1_chance change_variable = { name = oe_alb_kr_win add = 1 } }
    random = { chance = oe_alb_kr1_chance change_variable = { name = oe_alb_kr_win add = 1 } }
    random = { chance = oe_alb_kr1_chance change_variable = { name = oe_alb_kr_win add = 1 } }
    random = { chance = oe_alb_kr1_chance change_variable = { name = oe_alb_kr_win add = 1 } }
    debug_log = "oe_alb test kr10 (W8 formula): chance=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_alb_v_kr1p')|0]% held=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_alb_v_krwin')|0]/10 (league=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_alb_v_league')|0] c5=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_alb_v_c2')|0])"
    remove_variable = oe_alb_kr_win
}
